summary.en-US: Capture and share your personal YouTube recommendation feed snapshot with temporary links.

description.en-US: myfyp lets you capture your personal YouTube homepage recommendations and share them with a temporary link that expires automatically.

developer_comments.en-US: myfyp.link lets you manually capture a snapshot of your YouTube Home recommendations and share it with a temporary link. Open YouTube Home, click Upload Snapshot, and the extension parses visible video/Short cards, uploads metadata to myfyp.link, and returns share and delete links.

release_notes.en-US: Stability and UX improvements for snapshot sharing.

version.approval_notes: The extension runs only on YouTube Home and requires explicit user action to upload a snapshot to myfyp.link.
